basis.governing_question: Where can Iberia Foods identify savings of 8% of its cost base without cutting service levels?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Size the cost base by function and the savings available toward the 8% target without cutting service levels.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Sign off the savings case against the 8% target and service levels?

workstreams.name: Procurement
workstreams.answers: Where can purchasing costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze spend data by category and supplier
Interview buyers and budget owners on purchasing practice
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Manufacturing
workstreams.answers: Where can production costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze production cost and output data
Interview production and maintenance staff on cost drivers
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Finance
workstreams.answers: What does the cost base consist of, and do the savings found add up to 8% of it?
activities: Compile the cost base by function from financial records
Interview budget owners on how costs are allocated
Consolidate functional savings into one case against 8%

workstreams.name: Legal
workstreams.answers: Where can legal costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Review legal spend records and external service contracts
Interview staff who handle legal matters on workload
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Customer service
workstreams.answers: What service levels do customers get today, and what savings can customer service find without lowering them?
activities: Collect service-level data and customer feedback
Interview service staff on what drives cost-to-serve
Test savings options against the service-level baseline

workstreams.name: Logistics
workstreams.answers: Where can transport and distribution costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze transport cost and delivery performance data
Interview logistics staff and carriers on constraints
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Warehousing
workstreams.answers: Where can storage and handling costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze storage and handling cost and capacity data
Interview warehouse staff on handling and stock practice
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Real estate
workstreams.answers: Where can property and occupancy costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Review property lease and occupancy documents
Interview site managers on how space is used
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: HR
workstreams.answers: Where can people-related costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze headcount, payroll and absence data
Interview managers on workload and staffing practice
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: IT
workstreams.answers: Where can technology costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Review IT contracts, licenses and spend records
Interview IT staff and system users on actual use
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Sales and marketing
workstreams.answers: Where can sales and marketing costs fall without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze sales and marketing spend against results
Interview sales staff and customers on what drives demand
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

workstreams.name: Pricing
workstreams.answers: Which pricing practices add cost, and what can change without reducing service levels?
activities: Analyze price, discount and margin data by customer group
Interview commercial staff on how prices are set
Size savings options and test their service-level effect

deliverables.name: Procurement spend baseline and savings options
Manufacturing cost baseline and savings options
Consolidated savings case against the 8% target
Legal cost baseline and savings options
Service level baseline for testing savings
Customer service cost findings and savings options
Logistics cost baseline and savings options
Warehousing cost baseline and savings options
Real estate cost baseline and savings options
HR cost baseline and savings options
IT cost baseline and savings options
Sales and marketing cost baseline and savings options
Pricing practices review and cost savings options

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, streams and the 8% target
events.decision: Confirm the twelve workstreams and the 8% target as the scope?
agenda: Present the twelve workstreams, their timing and the steering meetings
Align on how the 8% target and service levels will be measured
Confirm data access and a client contact for each workstream

events.label: Workshop 1: cost baseline
events.purpose: Review the cost baseline and service levels
events.decision: Confirm the cost baseline and service levels the savings are tested against?
agenda: Present the cost baseline by function and the service level baseline
Review the first findings and savings options from the legal stream
Confirm the basis for testing savings in the other streams

events.label: Workshop 2: savings options
events.decision: Confirm which savings options go into the consolidated savings case?
agenda: Present savings options from the functional streams
Review the effect of each option on service levels
Decide which options go into the consolidated savings case

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Decide on the final savings case
events.decision: Sign off the savings case against the 8% target and service levels?
agenda: Present the consolidated savings case against the 8% target
Review the sales, marketing and pricing findings
Decide on sign-off of the savings case

architect_notes: Twelve streams allow one phase, named Diagnostic as the closest fit; the brief's design work sits inside it, not in a separate Design phase.
The performance improvement archetype's Implementation phase is dropped because the brief states an assessment only, with no implementation support.
Finance carries the consolidated savings case against the 8% target because the twelve named streams leave no room for a separate consolidation stream.
